commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) will replace Rocco Reitz.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 54042.
90+5' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90+5' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
90+4' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Stieler didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+3' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky!
90+3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

89' Today's match ends for Franck Honorat who will be replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).

82' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) controls the ball from the corner and produces a nice effort from inside the box towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel dives perfectly and deflects the ball onto the bar. What a spectacular save!
81' B. Monchengladbach win a corner.

68' B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

51' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) heads on.
48' What a chance to score from the free kick by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.

29' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Tobias Stieler signals a set piece.

27' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
23' The game is interrupted as Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is flagged offside.
22' Dortmund fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.
21' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
18' The rebound finds Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
17' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
16' Surely that's handball by one of the Dortmund players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

16' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.
15' Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
15' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
15' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
13' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
11' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
